# LITTORA
[color=#a4885c]Ship Size:[/color] Large
[color=#a4885c]Recommended Crew:[/color] 2-3
[color=#a4885c]Initial Generator Type:[/color] AME
A large but reliable armored excavation vessel with a large amount of cargo space, a backup air supply, and additional room for modifications. The Littora is a go-to choice for many seasoned expeditionaries.
